def: A provider-hosted tool that lets a model write and run code, typically Python and sometimes shell commands, in a sandboxed container holding uploaded files, and read back outputs, files and charts.
practice: The engine of analyst agents, since numbers come from executed code rather than model arithmetic; check retention terms, for example Anthropic’s code execution tool keeps container data up to 30 days and is not ZDR-eligible, as of November 2026.
